# Load data

```{r}
df <- readRDS("./data/dataset/CA_LTACH_first_clinical_per_quarter_CRKP_genomes_merged_studies_metadata.RDS")  
 
df_201415 <- df%>% subset(study == "2014-15")
df_202123 <- df%>% subset(study == "2021-23")
```

## A. Species Sequence type
```{r}  
df$Species_ST_recode <- factor(df$Species_ST_recode,levels = ST_scale$breaks)

A <- ggplot(data=df,
       aes(y=Species_ST_recode, fill=Species_ST_recode)) +
  geom_bar() +
  geom_text(stat='count',
            aes(label=..count..),
            hjust=-0.05, 
            size=3.5) + 
  xlim(NA, 370.1) +
  theme_bw_me +
  xlab("Isolates") + ylab("") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size=12, color="black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size=12, color="black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, color="black"),
                  legend.text =   element_text(size=12, color="black"),
                  legend.title = element_text(size = 12, color="black"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 0, color="black"),
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(size=14,color='black') 
  ) + ST_scale + facet_wrap(~study)

A
```

# B. ST clinical Klebsiella alluvial plot comparisons
 
## ST level 

```{r,fig.width=5.625,fig.height=4.5} 
ST_dist <-  df  %>%
    count(study, Species_ST_recode) %>%
    complete(study, Species_ST_recode, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
    group_by(study) %>%
    mutate(perc = n / sum(n) * 100)

ST_dist$Species_ST_recode <- factor(ST_dist$Species_ST_recode,levels = ST_scale$breaks)

ST_dist <- ST_dist %>% arrange(Species_ST_recode)
ST_dist$alpha_value <- ifelse(ST_dist$Species_ST_recode == "Singleton STs",0,0.75)

B <- ggplot(ST_dist %>% subset(n>0),aes(x = study,stratum = Species_ST_recode,alluvium = Species_ST_recode,y=perc,fill = Species_ST_recode)) +
  geom_alluvium(aes(alpha=alpha_value),width=0.66)+ scale_alpha_identity() +
  geom_stratum(width=0.66,linewidth = 0.075) + theme_bw_me + xlab("Study") + ylab("Percentage (%)") + ST_scale + theme(legend.position = "right",
                  axis.text =   element_text(hjust = 0.5, size=12, color="black"),
                  axis.title = element_text(size = 14, color="black"),
                  legend.text =   element_text(size=8, color="black"),
                  legend.title = element_text(size = 10, color="black"),
                  plot.title = element_text(size = 0, color="black")) + scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0,20,40,60,80,100))   + guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol=3))  + theme(legend.title.position = 'top')
 
B
```
 
# Overall figure

```{r,fig.width=9,fig.height=4.5}
AB <-  cowplot::plot_grid(A,B + theme(legend.position='none'),rel_widths =  c(1,.33),labels = c("A","B"),ncol=2)   

figure <- cowplot::plot_grid(AB ,ncol=1)

figure
```

```{r,fig.width=9,fig.height=4.5}  
ggsave(filename = "./figures/figure_1_taxonomy.png",plot=figure,width = 9,height = 4.5,dpi=900,bg = 'white')
```
